capabilities: open filled notes in reading mode by default
open empty notes in edit mode instead
switch quickly to editing when needed
extras: README also promotes the author's other plugins, Yesterday and Note ID.
problem: Obsidian opens notes in editing mode by default, which makes reading-heavy notes with footnotes, embeds, images, or code snippets less comfortable and can make links unclickable when the cursor sits inside them.
summary: Lightweight plugin that opens filled notes in reading mode by default and keeps empty notes in edit mode.
